name: Sylvie
source:
Members of St. Aile’s SORD team. Sylvie and [url=/c62420]Vel[/url] are third years, and therefore upperclassmen to [url=/c62418]Gumi[/url] and the others; as older students, they are allowed to wear nuns' habits instead of regular uniforms. They work as a pair during missions.

"Do I really look like a 'sly vixen' to you?"

[From [url=http://grisaia-pt.com/en/index.html]official site[/url]]
